Kyprosa Healers of Erenor look to Kyprosa, the unloved daughter of a mad King. A symbol of love and health, she is the figure behind the skills of Vitalism. Vitalism is the healing skill tree. It restores health with direct heals, heals over time and group heals, revives fallen allies and restores mana, and it adds blessings and cleanses for the party. It is usually paired with trees that adds crowd control, survivability or further healing. Kyprosa

Healers of Erenor look to Kyprosa, the unloved daughter of a mad King. A symbol of love and health, she is the figure behind the skills of Vitalism.

Vitalism is the healing skill tree. It restores health with direct heals, heals over time and group heals, revives fallen allies and restores mana, and it adds blessings and cleanses for the party. It is usually paired with trees that adds crowd control, survivability or further healing.
